cues.zh: 只是

cues.en: So you set everything up, you garbage collect every frame, so you make a pass through all the objects in your game heap. It's gonna take discipline to make sure that none of the big things stay in the game heap. You put all of your assets,
cues.zh: 所以你设置好一切，每帧做垃圾回收，遍历游戏堆中的所有对象。这需要纪律来确保没有大的东西留在游戏堆里。你把所有资产、

cues.en: resources separately managed. But the game stuff, you have it in the heap, can make a walk through at every frame. So it's this a fairly standard sort
cues.zh: 资源分开管理。但游戏的东西，你放在堆里，可以每帧遍历一次。所以这是一种相当标准的

cues.en: of compacting or broken hearts garbage
cues.zh: 压缩式或破碎心式垃圾

cues.en: collection where you pass through, you copy over the stuff that you still need to the next frame. So you... It takes twice as much space for for your heap. But the game heap, if you isolate out all of the constant data and all of the big media, it's not that large. I could guarantee that our our real mutable data,
cues.zh: 回收，你遍历一遍，把下一帧仍然需要的东西复制过去。所以你……这需要两倍的堆空间。但游戏堆，如果你把所有常量数据和所有大的媒体隔离出去，它就没那么大了。我可以保证我们真正可变的数据，

cues.en: you could count it... It counted in megs, not tens of megs. And it's probably only a few megs, so it's completely credible to walk it every frame.
cues.zh: 你可以数一数……它以兆计，不是几十兆。而且可能只有几兆，所以每帧遍历它完全可信。

cues.en: So you walk through the entire frame, you compact and copy it garbage collect to another frame, but you keep the old frame there and you memory protect it. And when you're fixing up all of these pointers, you know as you're doing that the garbage collection, you're marking pointers on whether they're in use, whether you've copied them over,
cues.zh: 你遍历整个帧，对它进行压缩和复制，将其垃圾回收至另一个帧，但你保留旧帧并对其做内存保护。当你在修正所有这些指针时，你知道在进行垃圾回收的过程中，你在标记指针是否在使用中，是否已被复制过去，

cues.en: but each entity keeps its own pointers to itself. But any pointer that it has to something else points to the frame that was just memory protected, that was garbage collected from. So any pointer that you get is either going to point to your state which is mutable, or if it's pointing to anything else it's pointing to a static copy. So you will bus error if you try to access that. It will be hard protected.
cues.zh: 但每个实体保留指向自身的指针。然而，它指向其他任何东西的指针都指向刚刚被内存保护的帧，即被垃圾回收的那个帧。因此，你得到的任何指针要么指向你的可变状态，要么如果指向其他任何东西，就指向一个静态副本。如果你试图访问那个，会遇到总线错误。它会被硬保护。

cues.en: So it's not possible to sneak in something that's going to be a race condition.
cues.zh: 所以不可能偷偷插入会导致竞态条件的东西。
